notes.title: Final fixes, as well as a prologue!
notes.content:
[h1]Hi friends![/h1]

[h3][b][u]In this update we fixed:[/u][/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Quest system
[*] Worked out a system for localizing the narrative (dialogues \ quests \ main menu)
[*] Lots of bugs related to AI (+ finalized it)
[*] Fixed character control
[*] Fixed car control on the remote control
[*] Improved and improved interactive system (interactive items\dialogs)
[*] Improved and fixed the mechanics of player interaction with the phone
[*] Lots of minor bugs related to gameplay.
[/list]

[h3][u][b]Added:[/b][/u][/h3]

[list]
[*] New story quests (1st story chapter)
[*] Added side quests
[*] Map optimization + improved optimization system (performance \ quality)
[*] Improved/improved many textures on the maps
[*] New sounds
[*] Changes on the map with the beach (added new buildings \ objects \ fauna)
[/list]

[b]In future updates, we plan to completely rework many game mechanics, make them more optimized and efficient. And also develop and add new story missions, develop the game story.[/b]

But we plan to focus on reworking / cleaning and debugging the game code so that all game processes and mechanics work according to our plans.
We also thank you for your feedback and comments on the gameplay and mechanics, which help us to adjust the development process and vector.

Keep in touch!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43116429/4bcbf791ef4e9f01a6c6aed952103d5a23320672.png[/img]

notes.title: Message to the community.
notes.content:
[h2]Atrio GAMES[/h2] - [b]original name from the A3 paper format, this type of paper is not standard in its form.[/b]

[list]
[*] Our team is only 3 people, and in addition to development, we undoubtedly have a personal life and work, we devote every free time to the development of the game.

[*] The JB project currently took 8 months of development. They flew by so fast that we do not even notice how quickly time flies, because we are passionate about our favorite pastime and are trying to turn the idea into reality and share it with you...

[*] The game went through several code refactorings, several changes in levels, direction of the scenario and atmosphere of the game. But one thing has remained unchanged - we are a team of 3 people!

[*] Our team strives to find very interesting and unusual gameplay of a very unusual concept. Over the past couple of months, when we finally made the project public, we received a lot of feedback and feedback on our game, it helps us to navigate in the direction that is really relevant and important in terms of gameplay.

[*] We want to further develop our project until it reaches a logical end. You can always support the project by purchasing it on your account, this will help us to increase our efforts in working on the project... Recently, we have been especially losing sleep in thoughts, ideas and work on the game, because we are trying to bring more and more new ideas to the game and mechanic.
[/list]

[b]Note that the game is not outright pornography, we are trying to make a game with vulgar humor, an admixture of satire and irony.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43116429/8829a98b3e5cb1be4cc4cedd379a983fa26a5e7f.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.2.1
notes.content:
[h1]We will fix bugs:[/h1]
• Remote control machine
• Changed interface in mini games [i](Car, drawing board, piano)[/i]
• Fixed bugs in music and sounds.
• Fixed a bug with the appearance of the cursor in the phone
• Phone bugs fixed
• Slightly refactored the code [i](Which will give a bit of an increase in optimization)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43116429/bb10764ffd87eecad89c901a710d56209d3dd3be.gif[/img]

[h1]What's new added:[/h1]
• When they take away our panties, the girls laugh at us.
• A test voice synthesizer appeared in the dialogues [i](It is barely audible due to the lack of high-quality sounds. Sounds are still in development)[/i]
• Added a red circle to visually display the scope of the girls [i](during attack)[/i]
• Added a white circle to visually display the scope of the girls (If you get into the zone, you will be attacked)
• Improved post-processing
• Slightly changed the appearance of the level
• Now the rescuers are slightly different from each other [i](Hairstyles, hair color and eye color have been changed)[/i]
• Piano now works when hovering over keys
• Girls got sounds and FX on the stands
• Girl's head has become a little more dynamic in the dialogues[i] (Now they are trying to look at your face from the stairs)[/i]
